claim_text: Smith, who accused Democratic Rep. Jasmine Crockett of Texas last September of using 'street verbiage' in her criticisms of President Trump, said last week that Trump-backed Florida gubernatorial candidate Byron Donalds might prompt him to switch his political affiliation from Democrat to Republican.
quote: he also praised the president, and said last week that Trump-backed Florida gubernatorial candidate Byron Donalds might prompt him to change his political affiliation from Democrat to Republican.
confidence_justification: Public statements by a public figure recounted in the report; the switch itself is described only as a possibility.
